subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Name and sequence days of the week and months of the year

show.line: Seven days make a week. Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday. Then the weekend: Saturday and Sunday!

rounds.prompt: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday. Which day comes next?
Which day comes before Tuesday? Say the day.
Count the days in one week. How many days?
School day or weekend? Put each day in its group.

rounds.story: Today is Wednesday. Ayesha has soccer in two days. On which day is soccer?

hints: Say the days from Monday. Stop at the one you need.
Saturday and Sunday are the weekend. No school!

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say the days after Tuesday.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I skipped Thursday. Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say them together. Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday!

parent_line: Can say the days of the week in order.
